stories.title: 'He likes the moment': Jackson Chourio was made for October
stories.summary: After a four-hit Game 3, Chourio is setting a new standard for young players in October.

stories.title: One win away: Brewers ride 8-run fifth to Game 3 rout, 3-0 World Series lead
stories.summary: The Brewers blew open Game 3 with an eight-run fifth inning and rolled to a 10-1 win over the Rays to move within one win of their first World Series title.

stories.title: Stokes hears MVP chants as stellar Game 5 puts Valkyries on brink of WNBA title
stories.summary: Kiah Stokes had 13 points, eight rebounds and three blocked shots -- accompanied by MVP chants -- as Golden State moved within one win of a championship in its second season.

stories.title: Dream's Smesko backs Reese, fed up with refs missing 'ridiculous' contact
stories.summary: Dream head coach Karl Smesko blasted refs for missing what he called a "ridiculous" amount of contact on Angel Reese in Monday night's Game 5 loss.

stories.title: Prescott says NFC East 'right in front of us' as Cowboys end 2-game slide
stories.summary: Dak Prescott threw three touchdown passes, and the Cowboys averted a three-game losing streak to keep pace in the NFC East with a 38-21 win over the Eagles.
